_comment: Row 648c. The row 648b cut was REFUTED (VERDICT-shape.md, upheld by O515) because the security floor read only the hoisted lock key / installed manifest, so a nested vulnerable copy escaped; O515 also folds correctness's residual ROW A (the floor value was pinned by nothing, S4 escaped). M1/M2 restore the hoisted-only lock and installed reads and must be CAUGHT by the nested-plant controls; M3 is S4 itself, the react-router floor lowered to 6.0.0, CAUGHT by the advisory pin (a floor value is unavoidably value-bearing: audited exception in test_row357 per OD rule 5); M4 blinds the pin's decision so no floor is ever off its advisory, CAUGHT by the pin's negative control. The band is every node of the floor file EXCEPT test_installed_frontend_dependencies_meet_secure_floors, which needs a node_modules provisioned from THIS lock and is scheduled in the node-provisioned parity-graph shard; the remote pool symlinks its main-era install into every band slot (bd-band-remote.sh), which reads 6.30.5 whatever the reader does, so a band that includes it is RED for reasons outside this spec (the 648c row326-spec lane showed exactly that: BD-MUTATE-UNRUNNABLE, baseline RED). Its reader is covered by M2 through the tmp_path control.
